sentences.japanese: それに全身全霊を傾けた。
sentences.english: He put all his heart and soul into it.

sentences.japanese: その箱は一方に傾いている。
sentences.english: The box is leaning to one side.

sentences.japanese: その塔はわずかに左へ傾いていた。
sentences.english: The tower leaned slightly to the left.

sentences.japanese: そのポールは左に傾いた。
sentences.english: The pole inclined to the left.

sentences.japanese: そのピアニストの演奏中、彼らは一心に耳を傾けた。
sentences.english: They were all ears while the pianist was playing.
